observation: Volatility annualised with (1+s)^12-1: reports 14.9% instead of 18.4%; the inverse error overstates stressed VaR by ~20%.
recommendation: Use square-root-of-time scaling and document the assumption.

observation: VaR is never compared with realised P&L, so there is no evidence the model is fit for purpose.
recommendation: Rolling out-of-sample backtest with Kupiec / Christoffersen tests and Basel traffic light.

observation: Normal distribution assumed; fat tails were seen in a KDE plot but never tested or reflected in the risk measure.
recommendation: Formal normality test; historical, Cornish-Fisher, Student-t and filtered HS VaR; add Expected Shortfall.

observation: The "VaR simulation" is circular: simulated paths re-estimate the input sigma, so they cannot confirm the VaR.
recommendation: Remove it as validation evidence; use simulation for forward distributions only.

observation: Only a 1-day 95% VaR: no 99% / 10-day measure and no Expected Shortfall.
recommendation: Report 95% and 99%, 1-day and 10-day VaR and ES.

observation: Fixed +/-5% outlier rule ignores the volatility regime; previous close is filled with a row-by-row positional loop.
recommendation: Volatility-adjusted z-score and Isolation Forest; vectorised shift().

observation: No data quality controls on the input file (duplicates, OHLC integrity, gaps, staleness).
recommendation: Automated DQ controls with exception log and reconciliation.

observation: No random seed, hard-coded /content path, dates not parsed, fragmented DataFrame built in a loop.
recommendation: Central config, seeded RNG, parsed dates, vectorised simulation.

observation: Stress testing limited to two volatility levels.
recommendation: Add regime, historical, hypothetical and reverse stress tests.

observation: Single index only; no portfolio or diversification view.
recommendation: Multi-asset portfolio with risk contributions and scenario P&L.
